source: Fieberg, Liedtke, Poddig, Walker, Zaremba (2024) JFQA
description: 28-indicator aggregate trend conviction score. Computes EMAs, MACD, RSI, Stochastic, Bollinger, volume, OBV, ROC, ATR and aggregates into a single [-1,+1] CTREND score. Orthogonal to momentum — measures TECHNICAL AGREEMENT not past returns.
entry_conditions: At least 10 of 28 indicators provide valid votes
Score represents consensus across all indicator families
academic_reference: Fieberg et al. (2024) 'A Trend Factor for the Cross Section of Cryptocurrency Returns' JFQA
